label: Sustaining versus existential inertia: esse-dependence sibling and the rival price
summary: Note docs/notes/sustaining-vs-existential-inertia.md; module TruthCore.Causality.SustainingDependence, spec specs/sustaining-dependence.toml. (1) Sustaining sibling of 2068f91c, the formal next test of the lane F esse-root assessment: 149ed837 (2068f91c restricted to causes of esse that sustain the effect in every history in which it is present) is derived from contact c4661518 and a new open co-presence bridge ffcb81fb (a distinct cause of x's esse present whenever x is, in every history, is one x depends on for its being; warrant: a strict conditional entails the counterfactual in Lewis/Stalnaker logics, given that the model's histories cover the relevant alternatives), result 1f2ae3c4; with ce55210c it gives 2068f91c, result f8519735; 2068f91c entails it, result 2574412d, relation e6d1be09. Controls 886615a9: the parent-child interpretation (originating cause absent after its effect's first moment) satisfies contact, the bridge and the sibling and falsifies ce55210c and 2068f91c; the bridge and contact are each needed; all hold together. So on this route the dispute over 2068f91c sits wholly in ce55210c and through 366a6ea3 in 40a97664; the origin-without-sustaining counterexample no longer targets the dependence step. (2) Owner-directed price map by direction of entailment. Onset fa3e228b and parity 5b24ef26 give concurrent actualization for begun things f4850897 (result d2e4867c), which 40a97664 entails (result 6d90f126, relation 413800c5); the inertial history satisfies onset and falsifies parity (controls part 5), and given onset parity is f4850897 restated, so it adds no price. The essence/esse union principle (q.3 a.7, statement 58445bd6) entails the crux only on a synchronic reading, which is 40a97664 renamed; its tenseless reading is satisfied by an originating cause. C* in the holding sense does not entail the crux (that branch's own control). The respect-general holding principle would entail more but the rival can reject it on independent physical grounds (inertial motion). Presentist actualist explanation forces a present explainer, not a giver. Finding: no independently warranted, non-re-presenting proposition entailing 40a97664 was found; extrinsic inertia's price at the crux is one item, plus its own primitive of diachronic sufficiency for existence; the routes resting on the crux (ce55210c, 23e04ae5, 9469ab62, 8bf775e9, the new support of 2068f91c, any C* reduction) are single points of failure, not price items. (3) Other tests: inertia's PSR variant is stable at local scope; physics is neutral at the esse scope and tells against a respect-general continuation principle only; explanatory depth favours conservation only conditionally on the crux; local parsimony mildly favours inertia. Judgment: no discriminating test available at matching scope; both stand with prices; no revision of the 2026-11-18 cluster judgment. Also recorded strong_version_needed on 366a6ea3 (it needs 40a97664, not its begun-things restriction).
blocker: The crux 40a97664 is unresolved against extrinsic existential inertia: every candidate test either presupposes one side's reading (parity, synchronic union), is neutral at matching scope (physics conservation laws, the cessation law), or bears only on a sub-version (Humean-law inertia, a respect-general continuation principle, a simultaneous persistence power). The co-presence bridge ffcb81fb is unassessed for history coverage. Next test: type present-tense receipt (ReceivesAt v z x t) and a receiving-giving correlativity premise to test whether DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN's present-tense reading makes 40a97664 near-analytic and moves the dispute to the reception bridge da72ae93.

current_assessment.scope: Sustaining causation of being against existential inertia (extrinsic and persistence-power forms) at matching scope, with the rival's itemised price by direction of entailment; the sustaining sibling of 2068f91c and its co-presence bridge; the onset/parity typing. current_assessment.assessment: No discriminating test is available at matching scope; sustaining (40a97664, ce55210c) and extrinsic existential inertia both stand. Sustaining's strongest warrant is a coherent standing-dependence account that unifies origin and persistence under giving and explains present actuality; its price is 40a97664 as a primitive, concurrence d7f5a528 (no warrant on file) and reception da72ae93. Inertia's strongest warrant is that the shared causal law on change with prior actuality yields persistence, PSR-compatibly and with one primitive fewer locally; its price at the crux is one item (reject 40a97664: parity given onset and the synchronic union principle are re-presentations, not further items), plus diachronic sufficiency for existence; the Humean-law sub-version also carries the explanatory-circularity objection. No independently warranted, non-re-presenting proposition entailing 40a97664 was found. 2068f91c keeps its direct option and gains a verified conditional support through ce55210c, contact c4661518 and the co-presence bridge ffcb81fb, on which it is no better than ce55210c; ffcb81fb is strong prima facie given history coverage, which is unassessed. Parity 5b24ef26 has no warrant beyond that of 40a97664. Nothing is established or defeated.
